entries.title: Leaks & Tracker routes fixed
entries.body: /leaks and /tracker no longer 404 or redirect to What's New. Click any Blook on Leaks for rarity, pack, notes, and CDN URL. Tracker shows full date/time on checks and updates.

entries.title: Tracker + Leaks pages added
entries.body: Sidebar entries for Leaks (secrets, Color Pack, gamemode leaks) and Tracker (CDN checks + update feed).

entries.title: Structured data + 5-min asset tracker
entries.body: data/packs.json, gamemodes.json, special-blooks.json, countdown.json, updates.json. GitHub Action probes CDN every 5 minutes.

entries.title: Snake Escape released
entries.body: Official Solo/Homework mode. Adventure + Endless. Was previously only a Plushie Panic arcade teaser.

entries.title: Plushie Panic released
entries.body: Solo capsule-matching mode. Background arcade machines name Fish Tank Trouble, Snake Escape, and Starstream Odyssey.

entries.title: Unreleased Aquatic Chromas still on CDN
entries.body: lemoncrab, poisondartfrog, rainbownarwhal, rainbowjellyfish, blizzardclownfish, donutblobfish, crimsonoctopus SVGs return 200 but are not in the market.

entries.title: Purple & Blue Astronaut assets exist
entries.body: Space Pack unreleased Chromas hosted at marketassets/blooks/purpleastronaut.svg and blueastronaut.svg (plus cyan/lime variants).

entries.title: Color Pack is the only secret pack
entries.body: Solid-color Commons. Only when all normal Commons are taken in a hosted game.

entries.title: Claw Mania / Fish Tank Trouble / Starstream Odyssey
entries.body: Claw Mania expected Season 8. Fish Tank Trouble and Starstream Odyssey only named in Plushie Panic background so far. Imposters was canceled.
